full_list.title_en: Biquaternion Algebra with Bilinear Multiplication: A General, Elegant, and Computationally Advantageous Framework for Relativistic Electronic Structure Calculations on CPUs and GPUs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Biquaternion Algebra with Bilinear Multiplication: A General, Elegant, and Computationally Advantageous Framework for Relativistic Electronic Structure Calculations on CPUs and GPUs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quaternion algebra provides a natural representation of time-reversal-symmetric matrix structures in relativistic electronic-structure theory, whereas complementary time-reversal-antisymmetric structures extend this representation to complex quaternions, or biquaternions. Here, we explicitly exploit biquaternion algebra for fundamental objects, including operators, kinetically and magnetically balanced basis functions, and their expectation values, within a unified framework encompassing real, complex, and real quaternion subalgebras as special cases. To realize this framework computationally, we have developed HMATLIB, a biquaternion matrix library implemented within the ReSpect package for pure CPU and hybrid CPU/GPU execution. A key development is a bilinear algorithm for matrix-valued biquaternion multiplication that reduces the number of real matrix--matrix multiplications from 64 to 24 compared with the conventional component-wise approach, while the biquaternion representation effectively doubles the maximum accessible matrix dimension under the same 32-bit indexing constraint. Numerical benchmarks on modern CPU and GPU architectures demonstrate that the biquaternion formulation consistently outperforms its isomorphic complex-algebra counterpart. For the largest matrices reported, hybrid CPU/GPU execution accelerates bilinear matrix multiplication by approximately 5-8 times over pure CPU execution and matrix diagonalization by approximately 12 and 61 times relative to CPU oneAPI MKL and NVHPC OpenBLAS, respectively. These results establish biquaternion algebra as a general and computationally advantageous framework for modern relativistic electronic-structure calculations.

full_list.title_en: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B 35, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted mathrm-CequivC- and mathrm-Li-F- chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.

full_list.title_en: Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this combined experimental and theoretical study, we investigate the role of disorder in governing the magnetic ground state of the quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe. In the FeRuMnZ (Z = Ga, Si) series, chemical substitution modifies atomic ordering and electronic structure, resulting in distinct magnetic ground states. Motivated by this, we extend the series to FeRuMnGe. X-ray diffraction reveals B2-type antisite disorder, where Fe--Ru and Mn--Ge intermix. Theoretical calculations show that such disorder modifies exchange interactions, leading to competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, and drives the system from half-metallic to metallic. Magnetic measurements reveal competing interactions, giving rise to a cluster-glass state coexisting with long-range magnetic order. The absence of a thermodynamic signature at T_f, together with ac susceptibility and relaxation measurements, supports the presence of short-range magnetic interactions and a glassy magnetic state. The compound exhibits an enhanced magnetic response below sim 161 K and a maximum magnetization of sim 1.64~μ_B/f.u. at 5 T. Overall, this work establishes a direct correlation between antisite disorder, competing exchange interactions, and glassy magnetism in quaternary Heusler alloys. Combined experimental results and theoretical calculations reveal that disorder drives the system from an AFM-dominated state in FeRuMnSi to an FM-dominated state in FeRuMnGe, providing deeper insight into the role of the extent of disorder in governing the magnetic properties of QHAs.

full_list.title_en: Global fermionic mode optimization via swap gates
full_list.title_zh: 通过交换门实现全局费米子模优化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2406.03449v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An optimal choice of single-particle modes leads to an optimal tensor network-based compression of the many-body wave function for systems of indistinguishable particles, which compression can be essential for large, close-to-critical systems. The proposed mode optimization relies on the minimization of the block entropy area, a global quantity that measures entanglement of the wave function along the one-dimensional chain of modes. Extension of the two-site DMRG algorithm by nearest-neighbor mode optimizations is straightforward, but it performs poorly without systematic reordering of modes. Moreover, finding a stationary optimal point in the combination of the fixed-rank MPS manifold and the unitary group of mode rotations requires optimization for every generator, i.e., for every two-mode pair. Here, a systematic joint optimization protocol over the MPS manifold and the full unitary group is presented in which every two-mode pair is accessed by a carefully constructed sequence of two-qubit operations, including swap-gate controlled permutations. Large-scale DMRG simulations of strongly correlated two-dimensional fermionic lattice models and the multireference Fe₄S₄ transition metal cluster demonstrate rapid convergence towards the optimum, achieving low energy and low entanglement.
full_list.abstract_zh: 针对不可区分粒子体系，最优单粒子模的选择能够优化基于张量网络的多体波函数压缩。本文提出一种在矩阵乘积态流形与完整模旋转幺正群之间进行联合优化的系统方案，并通过交换门控制的排列访问任意两模。大规模DMRG模拟表明，该方法可快速收敛到低能量、低纠缠的优化状态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 选择最优的单粒子模，可以实现对不可区分粒子体系多体波函数的最优张量网络压缩；对于规模大且接近临界的体系，这种压缩可能至关重要。所提出的模优化依赖于最小化块熵面积这一目标，该全局量度量波函数沿一维模链的纠缠。将最近邻模优化扩展到双位点DMRG算法是直接的，但如果不对模进行系统重排，其性能会很差。此外，要在固定秩MPS流形与模旋转的幺正群组合中寻找一个驻定的最优点，就需要针对每个生成元进行优化，也就是针对每一对模进行优化。本文提出了一种在MPS流形与完整幺正群之间进行系统联合优化的方案，其中每一对模都通过精心构造的双量子比特操作序列来访问，该序列包括由交换门控制的排列操作。对强关联二维费米子晶格模型和多参考态Fe₄S₄过渡金属团簇开展的大规模DMRG模拟表明，该方法能够快速收敛到最优解，同时实现低能量和低纠缠。

full_list.title_en: The Locality Cost of Fully Flat Hopf Insulators
full_list.title_zh: 完全平坦霍普夫绝缘体的局域性代价
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hopf topology permits a strictly finite-range Hamiltonian with one exactly flat topological band. We prove, however, that extending flatness to the complete two-band spectrum necessarily sacrifices strict locality or the gap: any gapped, Hermitian, translationally invariant two-band Hamiltonian with strictly finite-range hopping and two exactly flat bands has vanishing Hopf invariant. Equivalently, within this two-band setting, a Hopf band admits no compactly supported, translation-covariant, orthonormal Wannier generator. For factorized one-flat-band Hopf parents, the unavoidable partner dispersion equals the Gram symbol of translated compact localized states and encodes their nonorthogonality. Full flattening converts this dispersion into exponentially decaying but infinitely supported hopping. Model-independent bounds provide a sufficient criterion for finite-range approximants to retain the Hopf phase. An explicit model yields the axial decay length ξ_z/a=1/ln 2, parameter-free hopping tails, and residual bandwidths testable in circuit and photonic lattices. Hopf topology therefore does not prohibit a flat band but forces the locality--flatness cost to appear as either partner-band dispersion or nonlocal hopping.
full_list.abstract_zh: 霍普夫拓扑允许存在具有严格有限程哈密顿量和一个完全平坦拓扑能带的系统，但将平坦性扩展到完整的双能带谱必然牺牲严格局域性或能隙。本文证明，任何具有严格有限程跃迁、平移不变性、厄米性和能隙的双能带哈密顿量，只要两条能带都完全平坦，其霍普夫不变量就必为零。对于因子化的单平坦带霍普夫母模型，不可避免的伴随能带色散体现了紧致局域态的非正交性；完全平坦化则会转化为指数衰减但具有无限支撑的跃迁。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 霍普夫拓扑允许严格有限程哈密顿量具有一条完全平坦的拓扑能带。然而，我们证明，将平坦性扩展到完整的双能带谱，必然要牺牲严格局域性或能隙：任何具有严格有限程跃迁、能隙、厄米性和平移不变性的双能带哈密顿量，只要具有两条完全平坦的能带，其霍普夫不变量就必为零。等价地，在这一双能带体系中，霍普夫能带不可能拥有紧支撑、平移协变且正交归一的Wannier生成元。对于因子化的单平坦带霍普夫母模型，不可避免的伴随能带色散等于平移后的紧致局域态的Gram符号，并编码了这些态之间的非正交性。完全平坦化会将这种色散转化为指数衰减但具有无限支撑的跃迁。与模型无关的界给出了一个充分条件，用于判断有限程近似是否能够保持霍普夫相。一个显式模型给出了轴向衰减长度ξ_z/a=1/ln 2、无参数的跃迁尾部以及可在电路和光子晶格中检验的剩余带宽。因此，霍普夫拓扑并不禁止平坦能带存在，但会迫使局域性与平坦性之间的代价以伴随能带色散或非局域跃迁的形式出现。

full_list.title_en: Relaxation effects on Hartree-Fock ground states in twisted bilayer graphene at even integer fillings
full_list.title_zh: 偶数整数填充下扭曲双层石墨烯Hartree-Fock基态的弛豫效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A standard approach for studying magic angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG)'s correlated electronic phase diagram is to project the Coulomb interaction down to effective models only involving electrons in single-particle flat bands and some nearby remote bands. We provide a novel systematic derivation of a single-particle continuum model of MATBG's single-particle properties which incorporates structural relaxation while remaining in the Lagrangian frame. We project the Coulomb interactions down to electrons occupying the flat bands of this model and compute the Hartree-Fock many-body ground states at fillings ν = ± 2. We find that incorporating relaxation effects drives the model into a semi-metallic phase at - 2 because of particle-hole asymmetry in the relaxed model's single-particle dispersion and because the flat band wavefunctions become more concentrated leading to an enhanced Hartree potential. We discuss potential explanations for why such phases have not been seen in experiments.

full_list.title_en: Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. Due to anisotropic gapless superconductivity, altermagnetic superconductors with an out-of-plane Zeeman field display an anisotropic paramagnetic Meissner effect. The effect is strongest for parallel altermagnetic and Zeeman exchange field vectors and in the clean sample. The presence of nonmagnetic impurities leads to isotropisation and, consequently, weakens the effect; however, the paramagnetic response sustains intermediate amounts of impurities in the system. As demonstrated in recent experiments, microwave superfluid stiffness measurements can serve as a sensitive probe of gapless superconductivity.

full_list.title_en: d⁰-d half-Heusler alloys: A potential class of advanced spintronic materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：d⁰-d half-Heusler alloys: A potential class of advanced spintronic materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:1701.08397v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The possibility of ferromagnetic half-metallicity in lithium-based half-Heusler alloys, such as MnPLi, has been theoretically explored before [Damewood et al., Phys. Rev. B 91, 064409 (2015)], although at optimized lattice constants such lithiated manganese pnictides are predicted to be ordinary ferromagnets and therefore not suitable for spintronic applications. In the following, however, it is shown by first principles density functional calculations that half-Heusler alloys formed by 3d transition metals and d⁰ alkali or alkaline-earth metals, which are defined by the valence electronic configuration ns¹,²,(n-1)d⁰, can produce all kinds of half-metallic behavior at optimized lattice constants including the elusive Dirac half-metallicity that is theoretically predicted for the first time in a three-dimensional prototype MnPK. Together with the predicted magnetic and mechanical stability, this could pave the way for massless and dissipationless spintronics of the future. Among other technologically important features of the prototype Dirac half-metal MnPK, are the maximal moment d-shell ferromagnetism, high Fermi velocity of Dirac fermions that is comparable with that in graphene, and a wide half-metallic gap. Furthermore, by considering the prototype conventional half-metal VSbSr, the introduction of d⁰ metals is shown to substantially reduce the hull distance and produce true metastability in the otherwise instable chemical structure of zinc-blende transition metal pnictides--in this case zinc-blende VSb--without altering the `p-d exchange' that is mainly responsible for their half-metallicity, thus bringing their realization and potential applications in spintronics a step closer to reality.

full_list.title_en: In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analogue black-hole systems have been proposed in various physical platforms, including magnetic materials, offering rich physics and promising applications such as wave lasing. However, their practical realization and characterization remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an in silico study of magnonic black-hole phenomena in constricted ferromagnetic waveguides driven by spin-polarized currents. Using micromagnetic simulations with a two-dimensional Poisson solver to obtain realistic current-density profiles, we demonstrate the formation of a double-hole cavity bounded by analogue event horizons, enabling resonant spin-wave amplification. We characterize the resonances as a function of magnetic and geometric parameters and identify the corresponding spin-wave modes. We further show that gradual tapers enhance transmission by suppressing spin-wave reflections, while interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction can mimic the current-induced Doppler shift, substantially reducing the critical current density required for applications and, consequently, Joule heating. Finally, we demonstrate a spin-wave laser in which thermally excited spin waves undergo selective amplification and coherent emission at well-defined resonance frequencies. These results provide design principles for magnonic analogues of gravitational systems and point toward their potential for advanced spintronic applications.

full_list.title_en: Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic α-Fe₂O₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic α-Fe₂O₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The precession of the magnon pseudospin about the equilibrium pseudofield, the latter capturing the nature of magnonic eigenexcitations in an antiferromagnet, gives rise to the magnon Hanle effect. Its realization via electrically injected and detected spin transport in an antiferromagnetic insulator demonstrates its high potential for devices and as a convenient probe for magnon eigenmodes and the underlying spin interactions in the antiferromagnet. Here, we observe a non-reciprocity in the Hanle signal measured in alpha-Fe2O3 using two spatially separated Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector. Interchanging their roles alters the detected magnon spin signal. The recorded difference depends on the applied magnetic field and reverses sign when the signal passes its nominal maximum at the so-called compensation field. Our findings unlock the high potential of antiferromagnetic magnonics towards the realization of electronics-inspired phenomena.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic α-Fe₂O₃》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Precise spectral asymptotics, exponential localization, and spectral gap estimates for the three-boson lattice Schrödinger operator
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Precise spectral asymptotics, exponential localization, and spectral gap estimates for the three-boson lattice Schrödinger operator
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02488v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the three-boson Schrodinger operator on the two-dimensional integer lattice with pairwise contact interactions. First, we obtain precise asymptotics of the two bound states below the essential spectrum at zero total quasimomentum in the strong-coupling limit mu to infinity: the ground state energy is -3 mu + 6 + O(1/mu), and the first excited state energy is - mu + C + O(1/mu), where C = 4 - delta approximately 3.96458, with delta determined by the transcendental equation b0(delta) = 1/(1+delta) involving the lattice Green's function. The associated spectral gap is 2 mu + O(1). Second, using the discrete Agmon comparison method and the Paley-Wiener theorem, we establish exponential localization of the ground-state wavefunction with a logarithmic upper bound on the decay rate alpha(mu) at most ln(3 mu) + O(1/mu), reflecting the bounded nature of the lattice dispersion; the sharp asymptotic rate is conjectured. Third, at quasimomentum pi, the parity symmetry is preserved, but the odd quadratic form becomes positive definite with a unique eigenvalue of order 1/mu that never reaches the Birman-Schwinger threshold, so the odd subspace yields only a virtual level. The even subspace supports exactly one bound state with energy -2 mu + 6 + 8/mu + O(1/mu²), and the spectral gap to the essential spectrum is mu - 2 - 8/mu + O(1/mu²). The reduction from two bound states at zero to one at pi preserves the total spectral flow and is a lattice-specific phenomenon. Our approach uses an invariant subspace decomposition of the Birman-Schwinger operator and the Krein-Rutman theorem to guarantee uniqueness and strict positivity of the ground state. These results have direct implications for quantum simulation of few-boson systems in optical lattices.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Geometry of Altermagnetic Magnons Probed by Light
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Geometry of Altermagnetic Magnons Probed by Light
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2508.02781v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnons with momentum-dependent chirality are a key signature of altermagnets. We identify bicircular light as a smoking-gun optical probe for chiral altermagnetic magnons, selectively targeting their quantum geometry induced by an alternation of magnonic chirality. We show that in d-wave altermagnets, under a canting magnetic field, the altermagnetic magnons realize a nontrivial quantum geometry, resulting in an enhancement of the nonlinear second-order light-magnon interactions. We find that the scattering of bicircular pulses probes the present magnonic quantum geometry, even if the magnonic topology is trivial. Hence, our findings establish bicircular Raman response as an optical effect of choice to identify altermagnetic magnons. As such, we propose a universal experimental protocol to distinguish altermagnets from antiferromagnets by detecting their magnon chirality patterns with light, independently of the underlying magnon topology.

full_list.title_en: Spin Hall Magnetoresistance in Antiferromagnetic Insulators
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体中的自旋霍尔磁阻
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic materials promise improved performance for spintronic applications, as they are robust against external magnetic field perturbations and allow for faster magnetization dynamics compared to ferromagnets. The direct observation of the antiferromagnetic state, however, is challenging due to the absence of a macroscopic magnetization. We show that the spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) is a versatile tool to probe the antiferromagnetic spin structure via simple electrical transport experiments by investigating the easy-plane antiferromagnetic insulators alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite) and NiO in bilayer heterostructures with a Pt heavy-metal top electrode. While rotating an external magnetic field in three orthogonal planes, we record the longitudinal and the transverse resistivities of Pt and observe characteristic resistivity modulations consistent with the SMR effect. We analyze both their amplitude and phase and compare the data to the results from a prototypical collinear ferrimagnetic Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayer. The observed magnetic field dependence is explained in a comprehensive model, based on two magnetic sublattices and taking into account magnetic field-induced modifications of the domain structure. Our results show that the SMR effect allows to readout the spin configuration and to investigate magnetoelastic effects in antiferromagnetic multi-domain materials. We demonstrate that the SMR amplitude scales with the sum of the absolute sublattice magnetizations in ferrimagnetic and antiferromagnetic materials. In alpha-Fe2O3/Pt bilayers, we find an unexpectedly large SMR amplitude of 2.5E-3, twice as high as for prototype Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayers, making the system particularly interesting for room-temperature antiferromagnetic spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反铁磁材料具有抗外部磁场扰动和更快磁化动力学等优势，但由于缺乏宏观磁化强度，其反铁磁态难以直接观测。本文通过研究覆盖Pt重金属电极的赤铁矿和NiO双层异质结构，证明自旋霍尔磁阻可通过简单的电输运实验探测反铁磁自旋结构。结果表明，α-Fe2O3/Pt中的自旋霍尔磁阻振幅达到2.5×10⁻³，是Y3Fe5O12/Pt的两倍，显示出其在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中的潜力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁材料有望提升自旋电子学应用的性能，因为它们能够抵抗外部磁场扰动，并且与铁磁体相比可以实现更快的磁化动力学。然而，由于不存在宏观磁化强度，反铁磁态的直接观测具有挑战性。我们通过研究在具有重金属Pt顶电极的双层异质结构中的易面反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）和NiO，表明自旋霍尔磁阻（SMR）是一种多功能工具，可以通过简单的电输运实验探测反铁磁自旋结构。当在三个相互正交的平面内旋转外部磁场时，我们记录Pt的纵向和横向电阻率，并观测到与SMR效应相符的特征性电阻率调制。我们分析了这些调制的振幅和相位，并将数据与原型共线亚铁磁性Y3Fe5O12/Pt双层结构的结果进行了比较。观测到的磁场依赖性可以由一个综合模型解释，该模型基于两个磁性子晶格，并考虑了磁场诱导的畴结构变化。我们的结果表明，SMR效应能够读出自旋构型，并研究反铁磁多畴材料中的磁弹性效应。我们证明，在亚铁磁和反铁磁材料中，SMR振幅与子晶格磁化强度绝对值之和成正比。在α-Fe2O3/Pt双层结构中，我们发现了意外的大SMR振幅2.5×10⁻³，是原型Y3Fe5O12/Pt双层结构的两倍，这使该体系对于室温反铁磁自旋电子学应用尤其具有吸引力。

full_list.title_en: Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phenomenon of spin wave (SW) freezing occurs in the Damon-Eshbach mode in thin film magnetic systems, when SW phase and group velocities both go to zero, and the wave ceases to oscillate and move, preserving its shape as a domain structure pattern. This effect is related to the spin reorientation transition, where the magnetization configuration changes between the homogeneous in-plane state and domain structure with the out-of-plane magnetization component state. Here, we study the SW freezing effect in [Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ magnetic multilayers, induced by varying the in-plane external magnetic field. The studies were performed on nanostructures with the quality factor Q (ratio of uniaxial anisotropy to demagnetization energies) greater and smaller than one. Domain structures with an out-of-plane magnetization component were observed in these multilayers. The critical field, visible as the saturation field Hₛ|| in the parallel static magnetization curve measured by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID), is also manifested in the field-dependent vector-network-analyzer ferromagnetic resonance (VNA-FMR) experiment, which measures the homogeneous magnetization oscillations. Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectra, recorded for several values of wave vectors and several field values, probed the field-evolution of the dispersion relation. Micromagnetic simulations allow one to obtain a full dispersion, in good agreement with VNA-FMR and BLS results. Around Hₛ|| the simulated dispersion relations approach the conditions for SW freezing. Below Hₛ|| low and high frequency VNA-FMR modes are related to magnetization oscillations inside domain walls and within domains, respectively. The experimental results of static and dynamic behavior, together with micromagnetic simulations, create an overall consistent picture of the investigated multilayers.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
full_list.title_zh: 相干声子驱动反铁磁体中的对称性选择性非相对论自旋劈裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.01844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of Γ-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS₃, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an s-wave spin-split state with Δ(Γ)≠0, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a d-wave altermagnetic state with Δ(Γ)=0. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文表明，相干声子能够在共线反铁磁体中动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂，从而实现无需净磁化的超快自旋极化。Γ 点红外活性声子的激发会解除基态自旋简并，而保留下来的连接子晶格对称性决定动量空间中劈裂的形式。以 MnPS₃ 的第一性原理计算为例，不同的红外模式可分别通过光偏振选择性地激活 s 波自旋劈裂态和 d 波交替磁态；劈裂随声子振幅线性增加，并在位移反向时使诱导自旋极化反向。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体中的非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）能够在没有磁化的情况下实现自旋极化，为超快自旋电子学提供可能。本文证明，相干声子可以在共线反铁磁体中动态诱导并控制 NRSS。激发 Γ 点红外活性声子会解除基态的自旋简并，而剩余的连接子晶格对称性则决定所诱导劈裂在动量空间中的形式。由于相关红外模式与相互正交的面内光偏振相耦合，因此可以通过驱动光的偏振选择性地激活不同的自旋劈裂相。我们利用 MnPS₃ 的第一性原理计算表明，一种破坏所有连接子晶格对称性的模式会诱导出 Δ(Γ)≠0 的 s 波自旋劈裂态，而另一种在对称性上不同、保留连接子晶格镜面对称性的模式则会产生 Δ(Γ)=0 的 d 波交替磁态。在这两种情况下，自旋劈裂都会随声子振幅线性增加，并且当位移反向时，诱导的自旋极化也会反向。我们的结果确立了相干晶格驱动这一直接的、具有偏振选择性和模式选择性的途径，可用于在反铁磁体中动态诱导不同的非相对论自旋劈裂相。

full_list.title_en: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
full_list.title_zh: 系统展示代表性交错磁晶体能带结构中的自旋劈裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种展示共线交错磁体特有自旋劈裂的新方法：在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，以获得代表布里渊区平均特征的图像。该方法区别于只经过高对称点和高对称线的传统能带绘制方式，后者在许多情况下会完全隐藏交错磁自旋劈裂。通过对MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3等材料进行能带和对称性分析，本文明确展示了新方法的优势。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们展示了一种呈现共线交错磁体所特有自旋劈裂的新方法。该方法是在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，从而展示与布里渊区平均相对应的代表性图像。这不同于传统的能带绘制方式，后者沿高对称点和高对称线绘制能带，因此在许多情况下可能完全无法显示任何交错磁自旋劈裂。我们的研究将这种新方法与采用传统能带绘制方式得到的共线交错磁体能带结构进行了比较。我们报告了MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3的能带结构及对称性分析。结果清楚地展示了这种用于显示共线交错磁体自旋劈裂的新方法的优势。

full_list.title_en: Athermality of generalized Gibbs ensembles
full_list.title_zh: 广义吉布斯系综的非热性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.30762v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Integrable quantum systems evolving from non-equilibrium initial states do not thermalize to conventional Gibbs ensembles (GE). Instead, at long times they relax to generalized Gibbs ensembles (GGEs), which incorporate the full set of local and quasi-local conserved quantities. While GGEs have been extensively studied in the literature, a quantitative analytic characterization of how different they are from ordinary GEs is still lacking. In this work, we address this question by employing the concept of athermality, which we define within quantum resource theory as the relative entropy between a given state and the closest thermal state. By means of integrability techniques we compute the athermality for several quantum quenches in paradigmatic integrable models, including the free XY spin chain, the interacting Lieb-Liniger model, the XXZ spin chain, and the harmonic chain. We find that often the athermality becomes anomalously small when the post-quench Hamiltonian is critical in its ground state, despite probing physics at a finite energy density. We also prove that it systematically develops a singularity at criticality, which is inherited from the entropy of the GGE.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从非平衡初态出发演化的可积量子系统通常不会热化到普通吉布斯系综，而会弛豫到包含全部局域和准局域守恒量的广义吉布斯系综。本文借助量子资源理论中的非热性概念，以给定状态与最近热态之间的相对熵定量刻画广义吉布斯系综与普通热系综的差异。对多个典型可积模型的量子淬火计算表明，当淬火后的哈密顿量在基态处于临界状态时，非热性常会异常变小，并在临界点出现继承自广义系综熵的奇异性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 从非平衡初态出发演化的可积量子系统不会热化到传统的吉布斯系综（GE）。相反，在长时间极限下，它们会弛豫到广义吉布斯系综（GGE），后者纳入了全部局域和准局域守恒量。尽管广义吉布斯系综已经在文献中得到广泛研究，但对于它们与普通吉布斯系综究竟有多大差异，仍缺乏定量的解析刻画。在本文中，我们采用非热性这一概念来处理该问题；在量子资源理论中，非热性被定义为给定状态与距离其最近的热态之间的相对熵。借助可积性技术，我们计算了多个典型可积模型中若干量子淬火过程的非热性，包括自由XY自旋链、相互作用的Lieb-Liniger模型、XXZ自旋链和谐振子链。我们发现，当淬火后的哈密顿量在其基态处于临界状态时，非热性通常会异常变小，尽管此时探测的是有限能量密度下的物理。我们还证明，非热性会系统地在临界点发展出奇异性，而这种奇异性继承自广义吉布斯系综的熵。
full_list.summary: 从非平衡初态出发演化的可积量子系统通常不会热化到普通吉布斯系综，而会弛豫到包含全部局域和准局域守恒量的广义吉布斯系综。本文借助量子资源理论中的非热性概念，以给定状态与最近热态之间的相对熵定量刻画广义吉布斯系综与普通热系综的差异。对多个典型可积模型的量子淬火计算表明，当淬火后的哈密顿量在基态处于临界状态时，非热性常会异常变小，并在临界点出现继承自广义系综熵的奇异性。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《广义吉布斯系综的非热性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Nearly Complete Charge--Spin Conversion via Strain-Eliminated Fermi Pockets in d-Wave Altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 通过应变消除d波交替磁体中的费米口袋，实现近乎完全的电荷-自旋转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.21779v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ideal d-wave altermagnets with nearly orthogonal flat Fermi surfaces enable complete spin-channel separation and 100% theoretical charge--spin conversion efficiency (CSE). The metallic altermagnet KV₂Se₂O exemplifies this, but realistic samples host residual elliptical Fermi pockets that enhance charge conductivity while suppressing spin conductivity, drastically reducing CSE. Here we show that in-plane equibiaxial tensile strain systematically eliminates these parasitic pockets, restoring the flat-band geometry. Our first-principles calculations reveal that CSE increases monotonically with strain, reaching a record sim96% at 4% strain. An effective tight-binding model confirms that pocket suppression, governed by reduced next-nearest-neighbor hoppings, is the dominant mechanism. We further identify an unconventional out-of-plane spin current component with CSE sim55% at optimal orientations, enabling field-free perpendicular magnetization switching. Moreover, the same strain-driven removal of parasitic pockets yields giant TMR enhancement in KV₂Se₂O-based magnetic tunnel junctions, from 10⁵% to 10⁹%, and the giant TMR persists over a wide energy window near the Fermi level. These findings establish strain engineering as a clean, widely applicable strategy to maximize CSE and magnetoresistance in d-wave altermagnets, and provide predictive descriptors for screening high-efficiency spintronic materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 理想的d波交替磁体具有近乎正交的平坦费米面，可实现自旋通道完全分离和理论上100%的电荷-自旋转换效率。本文表明，面内等双轴拉伸应变能够系统消除KV₂Se₂O中的残余椭圆费米口袋，使转换效率在4%应变下达到约96%。同一机制还可产生约55%的面外自旋流转换效率，并将基于KV₂Se₂O的磁性隧道结隧穿磁阻从10⁵%提高至10⁹%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 具有近乎正交平坦费米面的理想d波交替磁体能够实现自旋通道完全分离，并达到理论上的100%电荷-自旋转换效率（CSE）。金属交替磁体KV₂Se₂O是这一情形的典型代表，但实际样品中存在残余的椭圆费米口袋；这些费米口袋会增强电荷电导、抑制自旋电导，从而大幅降低CSE。在本文中，我们表明，面内等双轴拉伸应变能够系统地消除这些寄生费米口袋，恢复平坦能带几何。我们的第一性原理计算显示，CSE随应变单调增加，并在4%应变下达到约96%的创纪录数值。有效紧束缚模型证实，费米口袋的抑制由次近邻跃迁减小所控制，这是其主导机制。我们还发现了一种非常规的面外自旋流分量，在最佳取向下其CSE可达到约55%，从而能够实现无外场的垂直磁化翻转。此外，由应变驱动的寄生费米口袋去除还会使基于KV₂Se₂O的磁性隧道结中的巨大隧穿磁阻（TMR）从10⁵%增强到10⁹%，并且在费米能级附近较宽的能量窗口内保持巨大TMR。上述结果表明，应变工程是最大化d波交替磁体中CSE和磁阻的一种清洁且具有广泛适用性的策略，同时为筛选高效率自旋电子材料提供了可预测的描述符。

full_list.title_en: Stability-threshold control of helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance
full_list.title_zh: 通过稳定性阈值控制手性选择性反铁磁共振
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.07488v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance in an antiferromagnetic-insulator/nonmagnetic-metal junction with sublattice-dependent damping and spin-orbit torque. By formulating the linearized Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation as a 2x2 non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem, we analyze the complex resonance frequencies and the stability threshold, using MnF₂ parameters as a representative example of a uniaxial antiferromagnet. We show that the absorption is strongly enhanced near the stability threshold, where one helicity mode becomes weakly damped, leading to linewidth narrowing and pronounced helicity selectivity in the sub-THz regime. The selected helicity can be switched by reversing the current direction, which reverses the spin-orbit torque acting on the interfacial sublattice. These results identify stability-threshold control as a design principle for electrically tunable helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance in uniaxial antiferromagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究了反铁磁绝缘体/非磁金属结中具有亚晶格依赖阻尼和自旋轨道力矩的手性选择性反铁磁共振。通过将线性化Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程表述为2×2非厄米特征值问题，研究者分析了复共振频率和稳定性阈值，并以MnF₂参数作为单轴反铁磁体的代表。结果表明，在稳定性阈值附近，某一手性模的阻尼减弱，从而产生增强吸收、线宽变窄以及亚太赫兹频段显著的手性选择性；反转电流方向即可切换所选择的手性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了反铁磁绝缘体/非磁金属结中的手性选择性反铁磁共振，其中阻尼和自旋轨道力矩依赖于亚晶格。通过将线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程表述为一个2×2非厄米特征值问题，我们分析了复共振频率和稳定性阈值，并以MnF₂参数作为单轴反铁磁体的代表性示例。我们表明，在稳定性阈值附近，某一手性模式会变得弱阻尼，从而导致吸收显著增强、线宽变窄，并在亚太赫兹频段产生明显的手性选择性。反转电流方向可以切换所选择的手性，因为这会反转作用于界面亚晶格的自旋轨道力矩。这些结果确定了稳定性阈值控制这一设计原则，可用于在单轴反铁磁体中实现电可调的手性选择性反铁磁共振。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-Selective Topological Magnon Engineering by Phonon Angular Momentum
full_list.title_zh: 通过声子角动量实现对称性选择性的拓扑磁振子工程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.28425v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamical control of Berry curvature remains an outstanding challenge in the engineering of topological phases. Here, we demonstrate control of magnon band structures via coherently driven phonons, based on ab initio spin-lattice coupling and Floquet theory. We show that this control is symmetry selective: linearly polarized phonons leave the spectrum unchanged, whereas circular and elliptical phonons carrying finite phonon angular momentum (PAM) induce chiral interactions that open and tune gaps at Dirac points, generating and reversing topological magnon phases. The gap magnitude and Chern numbers are directly governed by the PAM, enabling handedness-selective topology control. Applied to monolayer CrI₃, and supported by symmetry analysis, our results establish driven lattice dynamics as a general route to engineering topological bosonic excitations and a versatile platform for Floquet control of magnetism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理自旋-晶格耦合与Floquet理论，展示了利用相干驱动声子控制磁振子能带结构的方法。线偏振声子不改变能谱，而携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振和椭圆偏振声子会诱导手性相互作用，在Dirac点打开并调节能隙，从而产生或反转拓扑磁振子相。能隙大小和Chern数由声子角动量直接控制，并以单层CrI₃为例说明了这种对称性选择性的拓扑调控。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 动态控制Berry曲率仍然是拓扑相工程中的一个重要挑战。在这里，我们基于从头算自旋-晶格耦合和Floquet理论，展示了通过相干驱动声子控制磁振子能带结构。我们表明，这种控制具有对称性选择性：线偏振声子不会改变能谱，而携带有限声子角动量（PAM）的圆偏振和椭圆偏振声子会诱导手性相互作用，在Dirac点打开并调节能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相。能隙大小和Chern数由PAM直接决定，因此可以根据偏振手性选择性地控制拓扑。将该方法应用于单层CrI₃，并结合对称性分析，我们的结果表明，驱动晶格动力学是工程化拓扑玻色激发的一条普适路径，也是Floquet磁性控制的多功能平台。
full_list.summary: 本文基于第一性原理自旋-晶格耦合与Floquet理论，展示了利用相干驱动声子控制磁振子能带结构的方法。线偏振声子不改变能谱，而携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振和椭圆偏振声子会诱导手性相互作用，在Dirac点打开并调节能隙，从而产生或反转拓扑磁振子相。能隙大小和Chern数由声子角动量直接控制，并以单层CrI₃为例说明了这种对称性选择性的拓扑调控。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过声子角动量实现对称性选择性的拓扑磁振子工程》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Impact of the small Dirac component on the valence electron density of actinides at their nuclei in solids
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Impact of the small Dirac component on the valence electron density of actinides at their nuclei in solids
full_list.abstract: Author(s): A. V. Nikolaev, U. N. Kurelchuk, and E. V. Tkalya An enhanced Full-Potential Linear Augmented Plane Wave (FLAPW) method is introduced which incorporates the small Dirac components of valence states—specifically the 6p1/2 semicore states—in actinide solids such as Ac, Th, ThO 2 , and UO 2 . By accounting for these small components, it is demonstrated that the valence electron density at the nucleus increases by a factor of 2.4 to 4.3, correcting standard approximations in computational physics that omit significant valence electron density near the atomic nucleus. These refined relativistic Dirac calculations offer improved theoretical precision for nuclear phenomena such as internal conversion, Mossbauer spectroscopy, and electron bridge effects, providing foundational electronic structure insights relevant to technologies like 229 Th-based solid-state nuclear clocks. [Phys. Rev. C 114, 034601] Published Thu Sep 03, 2026

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.04390v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We find the asymptotic ratio between the storage capacities when enforcing real pre-activations in a complex hypothesis class as opposed to complex ones in the same class. We use weights drawn from the complex Gaussian, which converge asymptotically in norm to the square root of dimension almost surely. Our methods depend on Gardner volume-type comparisons at critical capacity. Our proof relies on an application of the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) formula, nonstandard in literature. With the HCIZ formula, we may obtain a more robust approximation for the final asymptotic ratio. This strategy is applicable to our work specifically since we integrate over the unitary and orthogonal compact manifolds, facilitated via the Weyl integration formula and the Haar measure.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们求得了在复数假设类中施加实值预激活约束时的存储容量，与同一假设类中允许复值预激活时的存储容量之间的渐近比值。我们采用从复高斯分布中抽取的权重；这些权重的范数几乎必然地在渐近意义下收敛到维数的平方根。我们的方法依赖于临界容量处Gardner体积型的比较。我们的证明依赖于对Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber（HCIZ）公式的一种应用，而这种用法在相关文献中并不常见。借助HCIZ公式，我们能够获得对最终渐近比值更稳健的近似。由于我们需要在酉紧流形和正交紧流形上进行积分，而这可以通过Weyl积分公式和Haar测度实现，因此该策略特别适用于本文的研究。

full_list.title_en: Quantum MeanFlow: single-shot generative sampling on NISQ hardware
full_list.title_zh: 量子MeanFlow：NISQ硬件上的单步生成采样
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02186v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum generative models offer a promising framework for exploring whether quantum computation can enhance generative machine learning. Flow matching is a generative method in which samples are generated by transporting a simple, known distribution to the target data distribution with a learned velocity field. Its quantum counterpart, known as quantum flow matching (QFM), was introduced recently, and, like its classical counterpart, requires integrating an ordinary differential equation over many time steps during inference. As each step requires the output from the previous step, the circuit submission is sequential and a drawback on quantum computers as they have high input/output costs. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Quantum MeanFlow (QMF), the quantum analogue of the MeanFlow formulation, which allows single-step sample generation. While the QFM learns an instantaneous velocity field at each time step, QMF learns the average velocity over a time interval. We use a parameterized quantum circuit to learn these velocity fields and benchmark the two methods on the MNIST dataset. We show that while single-step QMF has lower image quality compared to multi-step QFM, it performs better than the single-step QFM sampling at every shot count. Both of our models are executed on IBM quantum computers and best-of-N rejection sampling recovers most of the accuracy lost to device noise without modifying the circuit. This is especially advantageous for QMF which has only one circuit evaluation per image. Here, We establish QMF as a viable method for single-step quantum generative sampling, saving on quantum circuit evaluations per generated sample.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子生成模型为研究量子计算能否增强生成式机器学习提供了框架。本文提出Quantum MeanFlow（QMF），这是MeanFlow在量子领域的对应形式，通过学习时间区间内的平均速度实现单步样本生成，从而减少量子硬件上多步电路提交的输入输出开销。MNIST实验表明，单步QMF的图像质量低于多步量子流匹配，但在所有射击次数下都优于单步量子流匹配；在IBM量子计算机上的实验还表明，最佳N拒绝采样能够在不修改电路的情况下恢复大部分因设备噪声损失的准确率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子生成模型为探索量子计算能否增强生成式机器学习提供了一个有前景的框架。流匹配是一种生成方法，通过学习到的速度场，将一个简单且已知的分布传输到目标数据分布，从而生成样本。其量子对应形式，即量子流匹配（QFM），是最近提出的，并且与经典形式一样，需要在推理过程中经过许多时间步对常微分方程进行积分。由于每一步都需要使用前一步的输出，电路提交是顺序进行的；量子计算机较高的输入输出成本使这成为一个缺点。为缓解这一问题，我们提出Quantum MeanFlow（QMF），这是MeanFlow形式的量子对应方法，能够实现单步样本生成。QFM在每个时间步学习瞬时速度场，而QMF学习一个时间区间内的平均速度。我们使用参数化量子电路学习这些速度场，并在MNIST数据集上对两种方法进行基准测试。我们表明，尽管单步QMF的图像质量低于多步QFM，但在所有射击次数下，它的表现都优于单步QFM采样。两个模型均在IBM量子计算机上执行，而最佳N拒绝采样无需修改电路即可恢复设备噪声造成的大部分准确率损失。这一点对QMF尤其有利，因为它对每张图像只需要进行一次电路评估。在此，我们确立了QMF作为一种可行的单步量子生成采样方法，并减少了每个生成样本所需的量子电路评估次数。

full_list.title_en: Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.22667v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents an information-gain-guided reinforcement-learning sensor-selection framework for single-vessel tracking in heterogeneous maritime sensor networks. The proposed approach is motivated by information-theoretic sensor management: instead of activating all sensors or repeatedly performing computationally expensive online expected-information-gain evaluation, a learned policy selects one tracking-relevant sensor at each decision epoch. A Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo tracker estimates the vessel state from noisy measurements and provides a belief representation for scheduling under nonlinear and non-Gaussian conditions. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects one of five sensors in a georeferenced simulation of the CMMI Smart Marina testbed at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The policy is trained on the testbed's actual five-sensor configuration. The agent observes belief-state, detection-history, coverage, sensor-geometry, and realized-information-gain features. The reward is defined as a realized-information-gain term gated by an observability mask. Final-test simulations compare the proposed framework with random single-sensor selection, always-on sensing using all sensors simultaneously, and the expected-information-gain sensor-selection baseline proposed in our previous work. Results show that the learned policy achieves tracking performance close to always-on sensing while activating only one sensor per decision time step and avoiding the computationally expensive online entropy search required by expected-information-gain selection. Additional zero-shot evaluation without retraining on ten moderately perturbed versions of actual layout configuration showed broadly stable tracking, with any increase in positional tracking error remaining below 1 meter across all perturbations.

full_list.title_en: Network-incorporated Portfolio Optimization with Graph Machine Learning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Network-incorporated Portfolio Optimization with Graph Machine Learning
full_list.abstract: Financial markets exhibit complex interdependencies that conventional portfolio optimization approaches fail to capture. Here, we integrate dynamic stock correlation networks with graph machine learning to investigate how multiscale network information informs portfolio construction. We develop a hybrid architecture combining graph neural networks with Transformers to encode node-level features, local topological neighborhoods, and global market dependencies. Across the Chinese and American markets, each additional scale of network information improves risk-adjusted returns and sharpens allocations at the stock level, while the selected stocks remain spread across sectors. SHAP analysis identifies distinct topological features driving weight variation across assets, with features of higher distributional entropy exhibiting stronger attribution importance. Our results demonstrate that financial network topology provides interpretable signals for portfolio optimization, revealing how graph machine learning can exploit complex market dependencies that traditional frameworks overlook.

full_list.title_en: Empirical approaches to Fröhlich excitonic polarons in polar semiconductors
full_list.title_zh: 极性半导体中弗勒里希激子极化子的经验研究方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2505.07406v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The excitonic correlation between electron and hole and these carriers' interactions with underlying crystal lattice govern the opto-electronic response of semiconductors. The latter is dominated in ionic crystals by the Fröhlich interaction corresponding to the long-range electric field generated by polar phonons. Theoretical description of complex interplay of these two effects, excitonic and polaronic, has been a formidable challenge. The present paper reviews the physics of Fröhlich excitonic polarons from the point of view of empirical approaches and supplements it with a few original developments. At first, we review the models for excitonic polarons in ionic semiconductors built analogously to Lee-Low-Pines (LLP) model for free polarons, and later extended by Pollman and Büttner (PB). These models have been applied in past to the case of weakly interacting polarons (e.g. GaAs). We consider their applicability to ionic solids such as TlCl or 3D lead halide perovskites, where electron-hole correlations are relatively stronger. In these compounds, electrons and holes have almost equal effective masses, which allows us to derive a new analytical expressions of PB effective interaction potential. The refined Kane approach to PB's model is shown to (i) bridge the regime between weakly interacting polarons and excitonic polarons with strong electron-hole correlations and (ii) recover the LLP model for free polarons in the limit of vanishing correlation. Various developments carried out in this paper also include extension of Kane and PB's semi-empirical models to incorporate Fröhlich-like interaction with multiple polar phonons, essential for reconciliation of experimental observations in multi-atom systems. In the end, we discuss the relation of the empirical approaches with ab initio methods and provide an outlook of their application to lower-dimensional systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子与空穴之间的激子关联，以及它们与晶格的相互作用，共同决定半导体的光电响应，其中离子晶体中的弗勒里希相互作用尤为重要。本文综述基于经验模型描述弗勒里希激子极化子的理论，并发展适用于强电子-空穴关联和多极性声子体系的新表达式与模型。文章还讨论这些经验方法与从头算方法的关系，以及其向低维体系的拓展。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子与空穴之间的激子关联，以及这些载流子与 underlying 晶格之间的相互作用，共同支配半导体的光电响应。对于离子晶体，后者主要由弗勒里希相互作用决定，该相互作用对应于极性声子产生的长程电场。对这两种效应，即激子效应与极化子效应之间复杂相互作用的理论描述，一直是一个极具挑战的问题。本文从经验方法的角度综述弗勒里希激子极化子的物理，并补充若干原创性发展。首先，本文回顾了离子半导体中激子极化子的模型，这些模型仿照自由极化子的Lee-Low-Pines（LLP）模型建立，随后又由Pollmann和Büttner（PB）加以扩展。这些模型过去曾应用于弱相互作用极化子的情形，例如GaAs。本文考察其对于TlCl或三维铅卤钙钛矿等离子固体的适用性，在这些材料中电子-空穴关联相对更强。在这些化合物中，电子和空穴的有效质量几乎相等，这使我们能够推导出PB有效相互作用势的新解析表达式。我们表明，改进的Kane方法应用于PB模型时，可以做到两点：（i）连接弱相互作用极化子与电子-空穴强关联的激子极化子区域；（ii）在关联趋于消失的极限下恢复自由极化子的LLP模型。本文还开展了其他若干发展，包括将Kane模型和PB半经验模型扩展到包含多个极性声子的弗勒里希型相互作用；对于多原子体系而言，这对于协调实验观测结果是必不可少的。最后，我们讨论经验方法与从头算方法之间的关系，并展望其在低维体系中的应用。

full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、电子-声子耦合、极化子、载流子动力学、热载流子弛豫和光电性质研究直接相关。虽然主要是经验模型综述，但其中对激子极化子和长程库仑相互作用的处理可补充第一性原理和非绝热动力学研究。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可将弗洛里希耦合与第一性原理声子、介电响应及载流子有效质量结合，建立适用于具体钙钛矿材料的激子极化子模型。进一步研究缺陷、界面和温度对极化子形成、载流子复合及迁移率的影响。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 极化子、热载流子和非绝热载流子动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《极性半导体中弗勒里希激子极化子的经验研究方法》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Symmetric mass generation of interacting chiral fermions on a one-dimensional lattice without fermion doubling
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetric mass generation of interacting chiral fermions on a one-dimensional lattice without fermion doubling
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.24713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Symmetric mass generation is the interaction-induced opening of a fermion gap without spontaneous symmetry breaking. The anomaly-free 3-4-5-0 model of Wang and Wen provides a minimal one-dimensional setting for this phenomenon, but a direct lattice realization faces two obstacles: fermion doubling for local chiral discretizations and perturbative irrelevance of the six-fermion gapping interaction. We address both obstacles. First, we formulate the model on a strictly one-dimensional tangent-fermion lattice, where a nonlocal hopping produces a single chiral branch without a mirror partner while retaining an efficient tensor-network representation. Second, we add a Hubbard-type density-density interaction (Luttinger parameter K) that reduces the scaling dimension of the 3-4-5-0 interaction from 5 to 5K, making it relevant for K<2/5. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show the opening of an excitation gap in this regime without the appearance of a degenerate ground state, the hallmark of symmetric mass generation.

full_list.title_en: AGI Maze Prediction Datasets: A Compact Benchmark for Learning World Dynamics with Transformers
full_list.title_zh: AGI迷宫预测数据集：利用Transformer学习世界动态的紧凑型基准
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World modeling requires a predictive model to maintain and update an internal state adequate for reasoning about the consequences of actions. We introduce the AGI Maze Prediction Datasets and Benchmark, a lightweight controlled testbed for studying this capability in Transformers and other predictive models. Derived from procedurally generated, stateful grid worlds, the benchmark comprises per-step transition prediction, fixed-horizon state prediction, and sequential textual-observation prediction. Source-maze-disjoint training and validation splits, together with greedy exact-match evaluation, distinguish learning transferable action-conditioned dynamics from memorizing transitions in familiar layouts. We establish from-scratch byte-level Transformer baselines and compare them with two working-memory-augmented architectures. A generic auxiliary latent-memory Transformer can fit some training sets perfectly but does not consistently improve held-out performance. In contrast, a pseudo-video spatial-memory Transformer initializes a two-dimensional latent workspace from the input map and updates it from action history without receiving intermediate maps, positions, or state labels. Under the same data, objectives, and evaluation protocol, this model reaches perfect validation accuracy on selected fixed-horizon tasks where the byte and unstructured-memory baselines do not, and substantially improves sequential text-trace prediction. These results suggest that structured, task-aligned working memory can be more useful than additional latent capacity alone. More broadly, we argue that language grounding is mediated by persistent data structures and computations over them; the benchmark offers a compact setting for testing architectures that couple textual interfaces to learned structured state.
full_list.abstract_zh: 世界模型需要维护并更新一个足以推理行动后果的内部状态。本文提出AGI迷宫预测数据集与基准，用于在受控的状态网格世界中评估Transformer等模型的状态转移、定步长状态和序列文本观测预测能力。实验表明，与单纯增加潜在容量相比，结构化且与任务相匹配的工作记忆更有助于学习可迁移的、受行动条件约束的世界动态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 世界建模要求预测模型维护并更新一个适合推理行动后果的内部状态。我们提出AGI迷宫预测数据集与基准，这是一个轻量级的受控测试平台，用于研究Transformer及其他预测模型的这一能力。该基准源自程序生成的、有状态的网格世界，包括逐步状态转移预测、固定时域状态预测以及序列文本观测预测。训练集与验证集在源迷宫层面相互不重合，并结合贪心式精确匹配评估，以区分对可迁移的、受行动条件约束的动态规律的学习与对熟悉布局中状态转移的记忆。我们建立了从头训练的字节级Transformer基线，并将其与两种增强工作记忆的架构进行比较。通用的辅助潜在记忆Transformer能够完美拟合部分训练集，但并不能稳定提升留出数据上的性能。相比之下，一种伪视频空间记忆Transformer从输入地图初始化二维潜在工作空间，并根据行动历史对其进行更新，同时不接收中间地图、位置或状态标签。在相同的数据、目标和评估协议下，该模型在若干选定的固定时域任务上达到了完美的验证准确率，而字节级基线和非结构化记忆基线无法做到这一点，并且显著改善了序列文本轨迹预测。这些结果表明，结构化且与任务相匹配的工作记忆可能比单纯增加潜在容量更有用。更广泛地说，我们认为，语言 grounding 是通过持久化数据结构以及在这些结构上的计算来实现的；该基准为测试将文本接口与学习到的结构化状态相耦合的架构提供了一个紧凑环境。

full_list.title_en: CAPTURE: Disentangling Preference Drift from Memory Poisoning in Personalized LLM Agents
full_list.title_zh: CAPTURE：解耦个性化大语言模型智能体中的偏好漂移与记忆投毒
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.02265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Personalized language agents use persistent memory to adapt to users over time, but the same mechanism creates an attack surface. When new information conflicts with stored preferences, an agent must distinguish genuine preference drift from temporary context shifts, ambiguity, or adversarial memory poisoning. We formulate this problem as a continuous-time partially observable decision process over a latent user state and show why rules based only on recency and provenance are insufficient. CAPTURE addresses this ambiguity with a neural differential-equation belief tracker, a multi-timescale memory ledger, uncertainty-triggered clarification, and counterfactual auditing of cited memories. On 480 held-out episodes from 96 users, CAPTURE achieves a 71.5% win rate, compared with 69.3% for an identically supervised baseline and 66.1% for the strongest heuristic baseline. It limits fixed-policy poisoning success to 11.5% while accepting 83.5% of genuine preference updates. Under an adaptive attacker with access to the released weights, attack success rises to 24.7%, exposing a real adaptation-security tradeoff. We further evaluate the frozen system zero-shot on an independently constructed benchmark and replay longitudinal interaction histories from 40 users collected over two to three weeks. These results suggest that modeling preference authenticity explicitly can improve both personalization and robustness in memory-augmented LLM agents.
full_list.abstract_zh: 个性化语言智能体通过持久记忆随时间适应用户，但这一机制也带来了攻击面。当新信息与已存偏好冲突时，智能体需要区分真实偏好漂移、临时上下文变化、歧义和恶意记忆投毒。CAPTURE通过神经微分方程信念跟踪器、多时间尺度记忆账本、不确定性触发的澄清以及所引用记忆的反事实审计来处理这一问题，在480个留出情节上取得71.5%的胜率，并在限制投毒成功率的同时接受大部分真实偏好更新。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 个性化语言智能体使用持久记忆来随时间适应用户，但同一机制也创造了一个攻击面。当新信息与存储的偏好发生冲突时，智能体必须区分真实的偏好漂移、暂时的上下文变化、歧义或对记忆的对抗性投毒。我们将这一问题形式化为关于潜在用户状态的连续时间部分可观测决策过程，并说明仅依赖新近性和来源的规则为何不足以解决该问题。CAPTURE通过神经微分方程信念跟踪器、多时间尺度记忆账本、不确定性触发的澄清，以及对所引用记忆进行反事实审计来处理这种歧义。在来自96名用户的480个留出情节上，CAPTURE取得了71.5%的胜率，相比之下，接受相同监督训练的基线为69.3%，最强的启发式基线为66.1%。它将固定策略下的投毒成功率限制在11.5%，同时接受83.5%的真实偏好更新。在攻击者能够访问已发布权重的自适应攻击场景下，攻击成功率上升到24.7%，揭示出适应能力与安全性之间真实存在的权衡。我们还在一个独立构建的基准上对冻结系统进行了零样本评估，并重放了从40名用户处收集、持续两到三周的纵向交互历史。这些结果表明，显式建模偏好真实性，能够同时提升记忆增强型大语言模型智能体的个性化能力与鲁棒性。
full_list.summary: 个性化语言智能体通过持久记忆随时间适应用户，但这一机制也带来了攻击面。当新信息与已存偏好冲突时，智能体需要区分真实偏好漂移、临时上下文变化、歧义和恶意记忆投毒。CAPTURE通过神经微分方程信念跟踪器、多时间尺度记忆账本、不确定性触发的澄清以及所引用记忆的反事实审计来处理这一问题，在480个留出情节上取得71.5%的胜率，并在限制投毒成功率的同时接受大部分真实偏好更新。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《CAPTURE：解耦个性化大语言模型智能体中的偏好漂移与记忆投毒》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Beyond Prompt Injection: Trust-Boundary Security Assurance for LLM-Integrated and Agentic Applications
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Beyond Prompt Injection: Trust-Boundary Security Assurance for LLM-Integrated and Agentic Applications
full_list.abstract: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly combine probabilistic language interpretation with retrieval, persistent memory, external tools, and delegated enterprise credentials. This creates a system-security problem in which untrusted semantic content can cross trust boundaries and acquire operational authority. Existing work provides prompt-injection attacks, agent benchmarks, risk taxonomies, and governance guidance, but less directly addresses how those threats should be translated into verifiable controls for a deployed application. This paper presents a trust-boundary security assurance framework for LLM-integrated and agentic systems. The framework models the application as a mediated-authority system, identifies six architectural threat surfaces and seven recurring trust boundaries, and represents attack paths through source, mechanism, boundary, privilege, asset, and outcome. It then operationalizes the model through a six-stage assurance process covering system decomposition, authority mapping, adversarial scenario construction, boundary-control verification, containment and detection analysis, and evidence-based reporting. A dedicated Model Context Protocol (MCP) profile distinguishes protocol security, semantic trust, and enterprise authorization. The framework further connects defensive controls to observable evidence and proposes a decomposed measurement profile covering attack success, boundary interception, benign-task preservation, blast-radius characteristics, detection latency, and undetected events. A worked enterprise RAG--MCP scenario illustrates how the framework traces an indirect injection from retrieved content through delegated authority to an authorization decision and auditable evidence. The contribution is methodological rather than an empirical claim of defense superiority: it provides a traceable structure for converting evolving LLM and agent threats into testable security claims and application-level assurance evidence.

core_items.title_zh: 金属交替磁体 KV₂Se₂O 中的磁振子
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.01853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the spin excitation in altermagnetic vanadium oxyselenides, focusing on the metallic quasi-two-dimensional compound KV₂Se₂O. Using a fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations, we compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation and extract the magnon dispersion relation. We show that the altermagnetic symmetry leads to characteristic degeneracies and directional splittings in both the electronic bands and the magnon spectra along high-symmetry paths of the Brillouin zone. The metallic KV₂Se₂O exhibits finite magnon linewidths arising from the coupling to the particle-hole continuum. Furthermore, by fixing the magnitude of the wave vector and varying its in-plane direction, we uncover a pronounced angular dependence of the magnon energies and lifetimes, with complementary damping behavior between the two magnon branches. Upon including spin-orbit coupling, the system exhibits an out-of-plane easy c-axis anisotropy, which opens a magnon gap of approximately 6 meV at the Γ-point, possibly rendering the magnetic order stable at room temperature. Our results demonstrate that altermagnetism controls not only the dispersion but also the anisotropic decay of spin excitations, highlighting altermagnetic metals as promising platforms for directionally selective magnon transport.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文研究交替磁性钒氧硒化物中的自旋激发，重点考察金属准二维化合物 KV₂Se₂O，并利用由第一性原理计算导出的费米子哈密顿量计算横向自旋磁化率和磁振子色散。交替磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱在布里渊区高对称路径上出现特征简并与方向性劈裂；由于与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合，金属体系中的磁振子具有有限线宽。自旋轨道耦合产生面外易磁化 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，并可能使磁有序在室温下保持稳定。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究交替磁性钒氧硒化物中的自旋激发，重点关注金属准二维化合物 KV₂Se₂O。我们使用由第一性原理计算导出的费米子哈密顿量，在随机相位近似下计算横向自旋磁化率，并提取磁振子色散关系。我们表明，交替磁对称性会在布里渊区的高对称路径上，使电子能带和磁振子谱同时呈现特征性的简并与方向性劈裂。金属 KV₂Se₂O 中的磁振子由于与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合而具有有限的线宽。此外，通过固定波矢的大小并改变其面内方向，我们发现磁振子能量和寿命具有显著的角度依赖性，并且两个磁振支之间表现出互补的阻尼行为。加入自旋轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易磁化 c 轴各向异性，并在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，这可能使磁有序在室温下保持稳定。我们的结果表明，交替磁性不仅控制自旋激发的色散，还控制其各向异性的衰减特性，凸显了交替磁金属作为方向选择性磁振子输运平台的潜力。
core_items.summary: 本文研究交替磁性钒氧硒化物中的自旋激发，重点考察金属准二维化合物 KV₂Se₂O，并利用由第一性原理计算导出的费米子哈密顿量计算横向自旋磁化率和磁振子色散。交替磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱在布里渊区高对称路径上出现特征简并与方向性劈裂；由于与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合，金属体系中的磁振子具有有限线宽。自旋轨道耦合产生面外易磁化 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，并可能使磁有序在室温下保持稳定。
core_items.focus_summary: 论文研究金属准二维交替磁体 KV₂Se₂O 中的自旋激发，基于第一性原理导出的费米子哈密顿量和随机相位近似计算磁振子色散。研究发现交替磁对称性导致磁振子能带的简并和方向分裂，粒子-空穴连续谱引起有限线宽，加入自旋轨道耦合后在 Γ 点产生约 6 meV 的磁振子带隙。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的交替磁性、磁性材料、第一性原理哈密顿量、自旋激发、自旋轨道耦合和磁阻尼研究高度直接相关。其从电子结构到磁振子谱及寿命的计算流程，可作为发展自旋哈密顿量、磁动力学和机器学习磁性模型的重要参考。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步研究应变、层间堆垛、缺陷和温度对 KV₂Se₂O 磁振子谱及阻尼的影响，并构建包含长程交换和自旋轨道耦合的有效自旋模型。还可结合机器学习哈密顿量或自旋-晶格动力学，模拟有限温度下的磁振子输运与稳定性。
core_items.method_point: 文章从第一性原理计算得到KV2Se2O的费米子哈密顿量，在给定反铁磁或交替磁基态、布里渊区采样和自旋轨道耦合参数后，计算横向自旋磁化率并由其极点提取磁振子色散。电子-空穴连续谱造成磁振子有限线宽，SOC引入约6 meV的Γ点能隙和c轴易磁化；摘要未说明是否使用DFT+U、Wannier化细节及展宽参数。
core_items.related_work: 该路线与Hongjun Xiang和Xin-Gao Gong开展的自旋哈密顿量、非共线磁性、SOC和拓扑磁激发计算相呼应，但重点从绝缘体局域自旋模型转向金属体系的电子响应函数。KV2Se2O的方向性劈裂可与CrSb、CrSBr及CrI3中的交替磁或范德华磁性比较；有限线宽不能仅由Heisenberg模型给出，需要保留费米面粒子-空穴阻尼和动量分辨的电子结构。
core_items.implication: 可对KV2Se2O、CrSb和CrSBr建立统一工作流：用非共线DFT+U+SOC计算多个磁序，Wannier化V-d、Se-p或卤素-p轨道，随后评估动态自旋磁化率、阻尼和外场依赖。以等变GNN学习不同应变、层间距离和自旋构型下的哈密顿量，和直接DFT比较能带、交换参数、Γ点能隙及磁振子谱，最终用有限温自旋动力学检验室温稳定性。

core_items.title_zh: g波交替磁性多极矩的观测
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.01969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a g-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in g-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the g-wave multipole and the g-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.
core_items.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是近年来出现的一类具有破缺时间反演对称性的共线磁体，其时间反演对称性破缺源于与高阶多极矩锁定的反铁磁型磁偶极矩，而非铁磁体中的净磁化。本文结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射和价电子密度分析，在典型交替磁体CrSb中直接观测到g波交替磁性多极矩。研究发现，Cr子晶格之间交替出现显著的价电子密度方向各向异性，并通过偏振中子衍射探测到与之共存的铁磁型磁多极矩，从而为交替磁性及隐藏多极有序提供了实空间证据。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几年中，交替磁体作为一类具有破缺时间反演对称性的共线磁体逐渐受到关注，为超越传统磁体的自旋电子学提供了新的机会。与铁磁体中的净磁化不同，交替磁体中非常规的时间反演对称性破缺源于锁定于高阶多极矩的反铁磁型磁偶极矩。本文报告了在典型交替磁体CrSb中对g波交替磁性多极矩的直接可视化观测。通过结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射与价电子密度（VED）分析，我们揭示了价电子密度分布的显著方向各向异性，并且这种各向异性在不同Cr子晶格之间交替出现。这一结果证明了g波交替磁体中所预测的电十六极矩反铁磁型有序。该有序与反铁磁型磁偶极矩共存，并诱导出铁磁型磁多极矩，这一点通过偏振中子衍射得到了探测。我们进一步确定了交替磁性的微观模型，该模型直接联系了g波多极矩与g波自旋劈裂。通过直接观测和量化多极矩，本研究提供了交替磁性的实空间指纹，并建立了一种探测量子材料中隐藏多极有序的通用方法。
core_items.summary: 交替磁体是近年来出现的一类具有破缺时间反演对称性的共线磁体，其时间反演对称性破缺源于与高阶多极矩锁定的反铁磁型磁偶极矩，而非铁磁体中的净磁化。本文结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射和价电子密度分析，在典型交替磁体CrSb中直接观测到g波交替磁性多极矩。研究发现，Cr子晶格之间交替出现显著的价电子密度方向各向异性，并通过偏振中子衍射探测到与之共存的铁磁型磁多极矩，从而为交替磁性及隐藏多极有序提供了实空间证据。
core_items.focus_summary: 论文通过高能同步辐射 X 射线衍射、价电子密度分析和偏振中子衍射，直接观测了 CrSb 中的 g 波交替磁多极矩。研究揭示了电六十四极矩与反铁磁磁偶极矩共存，并建立了高阶多极矩与 g 波自旋劈裂之间的微观联系。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队关注的交替磁性、磁性拓扑性质、对称性分析和自旋劈裂方向高度相关，提供了交替磁多极矩的实验验证和微观解释。该工作可帮助团队将第一性原理预测的交替磁结构与多极矩表征、实验可观测量联系起来。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议结合对称性分析和第一性原理电子结构计算，研究 CrSb 中多极矩、自旋劈裂、磁交换及自旋轨道耦合之间的定量关系。还可筛选具有类似 g 波多极序的二维或层状材料，并评估其自旋输运和光学响应。
core_items.method_point: 该研究结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射、价电子密度分析和偏振中子衍射，在CrSb中解析Cr子晶格的方向性价电子密度交替，并识别共存的铁磁型磁多极矩。其关键不是机器学习模型，而是利用衍射结构因子、极化选择定则和实空间电子密度重构区分g波交替磁多极序；摘要未给出反演算法、分辨率和拟合统计量。
core_items.related_work: g波多极矩观测与Hongjun Xiang关于反铁磁、交替磁性、群论和非共线磁结构的研究高度相关，也为Xin-Gao Gong关注的拓扑及自旋相关材料提供实验约束。相较仅由DFT能带自旋劈裂判定altermagnetism，该工作把高阶空间对称性信息落实到电荷密度和磁多极矩通道；但它不等同于机器学习预测，ML更适合承担候选结构、衍射谱拟合和不确定度分析。
core_items.implication: 可将CrSb的实验约束转化为CrI3、CrSBr、KV2Se2O及二维NbOI2候选体系的多极序筛选任务。先用DFT+U+SOC生成不同磁序、应变和缺陷下的电荷密度与磁化密度，再以对称性适配的等变GNN预测多极矩张量和衍射强度，训练集按磁空间群分层。用全波DFT、偏振X射线或中子可观测结构因子验证，并检查模型是否区分普通反铁磁与真正交替磁序。

core_items.title_en: First Principle Analysis of the Magnetism and Electronic Structure of Fe2XSi (X=Ti, V)
core_items.title_zh: Fe2XSi（X=Ti、V）的磁性与电子结构的第一性原理分析
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.02800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Fe2XSi, where X is titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V), are investigated using computational methods. Volume optimization reveals that the ground state of Fe2TiSi is a nonmagnetic narrow-band gap semiconductor, and that of Fe2VSi is a ferrimagnetic metal. The negative formation energies of both materials confirm the stability of their crystal structures. Mechanical properties confirm the static stability of the crystal structure and suggest that the titanium compound is ductile; however, the vanadium material is brittle. Density of states and band structure studies confirm the nonmagnetic semiconducting nature with an indirect band gap at Γ and X for the titanium material and the ferrimagnetic-metallic nature of the vanadium material. Electronic and magnetic properties of the materials were investigated with applied tension (negative pressure) and compression (positive pressure) to the crystal structure. The pressure study on Fe2TiSi shows a tunable band gap and a possible semiconductor-metal transition, and Fe2VSi shows a tunable magnetic moment and a possible low-spin/high-spin magnetic transition.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文采用计算方法研究Fe2XSi（X为钛或钒）的电子、磁学和力学性质。体积优化表明，Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，而Fe2VSi是亚铁磁金属；两种材料的负形成能证实了其晶体结构稳定性。力学性质表明钛化合物具有延展性，而钒化合物较为脆性。压力研究显示，Fe2TiSi的带隙可调并可能发生半导体-金属转变，Fe2VSi的磁矩可调并可能发生低自旋-高自旋磁性转变。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用计算方法研究了Fe2XSi的电子、磁学和力学性质，其中X为钛（Ti）和钒（V）。体积优化表明，Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，而Fe2VSi的基态是亚铁磁金属。两种材料的负形成能证实了其晶体结构的稳定性。力学性质证实了晶体结构的静态稳定性，并表明钛化合物具有延展性；然而，钒化合物是脆性的。态密度和能带结构研究证实，钛化合物具有非磁性半导体性质，在Γ点和X点之间存在间接带隙；同时也证实了钒化合物具有亚铁磁金属性质。在对晶体结构施加拉伸应力（负压力）和压缩应力（正压力）时，我们研究了这些材料的电子和磁学性质。对Fe2TiSi的压力研究表明，其带隙可调，并可能发生半导体-金属转变；对Fe2VSi的研究表明，其磁矩可调，并可能发生低自旋-高自旋磁性转变。
core_items.summary: 本文采用计算方法研究Fe2XSi（X为钛或钒）的电子、磁学和力学性质。体积优化表明，Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，而Fe2VSi是亚铁磁金属；两种材料的负形成能证实了其晶体结构稳定性。力学性质表明钛化合物具有延展性，而钒化合物较为脆性。压力研究显示，Fe2TiSi的带隙可调并可能发生半导体-金属转变，Fe2VSi的磁矩可调并可能发生低自旋-高自旋磁性转变。
core_items.focus_summary: 论文使用第一性原理方法研究Fe2TiSi和Fe2VSi的电子、磁性及力学性质，并考察拉伸和压缩对其性质的调控作用。结果表明Fe2TiSi是窄带隙非磁性半导体，Fe2VSi是亚铁磁金属，压力可分别调节带隙、磁矩以及可能的自旋态转变。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理电子结构、磁性材料、铁磁或亚铁磁体系、压力调控和高通量材料筛选方向相关。其研究内容较为基础，但可作为探索磁性半导体、半金属和应变调控磁性的参考案例。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步验证不同磁性构型、交换关联泛函和自旋轨道耦合对结论的影响，并计算交换参数和磁相变温度。后续可结合高通量筛选寻找具有更稳定磁序、较大自旋极化和可调拓扑性质的类似Heusler材料。
core_items.method_point: 研究对Fe2TiSi和Fe2VSi进行晶格参数和体积优化，比较自旋极化电子结构、形成能、弹性常数、延展性指标及压力下的能带和磁矩变化。结果给出Fe2TiSi为非磁性窄带隙半导体、Fe2VSi为亚铁磁金属，并据压力扫描讨论半导体-金属及低自旋-高自旋转变；摘要未交代交换关联泛函、U值、k点和压力步长。
core_items.related_work: 该工作属于常规第一性原理材料筛选，与团队的高通量磁性、半导体和压力调控研究相连，但摘要没有机器学习环节，ML×凝聚态关联主要体现在可作为数据生成基准。Fe2XSi的磁矩可调性可与Hongjun Xiang的自旋哈密顿量和Xin-Gao Gong的交替磁性方向衔接，也可借鉴Ji-Hui Yang对输运和电子-声子耦合的分析，补足仅比较静态磁矩的局限。
core_items.implication: 建议建立Fe2XSi及相关Heusler合金的DFT+U+SOC数据库，扫描组分、体积、双轴应变和不同磁序，记录能带、交换分裂、形成能、弹性张量与声子稳定性。以等变哈密顿量GNN学习轨道分辨矩阵，再对候选材料计算Wannier输运、磁振子和有限温磁序；用全DFT复算转变压力，并以实验晶格常数、磁矩和电阻率作外部验证。

core_items.title_en: Machine-learning screening and first-principles lattice dynamics resolve the most stable structure of NaCa(BH₄)₃ from a data-driven candidate search
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习筛选与第一性原理晶格动力学从数据驱动候选搜索中确定NaCa(BH4)3的最稳定结构
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.02001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equimolar NaCa(BH₄)₃ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH₄ and Ca(BH₄)₂, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX₃ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at -4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to -2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.
core_items.abstract_zh: NaCa(BH4)3具有11.24 wt.%的理论储氢容量，但此前从未制备成功，也没有报道其晶体结构。本文从多个来源构建候选结构，对所有电荷中性的阳离子排列进行穷举，并结合机器学习势与第一性原理计算进行筛选和确认。结果表明，最稳定结构不是钙钛矿，而是仅由无约束搜索发现的单斜Cm框架；其声子谱和弹性张量均显示稳定性，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在虚频，这为该组成难以形成钙钛矿结构提供了物理解释。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 等摩尔比NaCa(BH4)3的理论储氢容量为11.24 wt.%，其分解焓预计介于NaBH4和Ca(BH4)2之间，但该化合物从未被制备出来，也没有报道其晶体结构。此前对它的预测一直建立在钙钛矿家族结构之上，因为其较重的同系物采用了这类结构。本文取消了这一假设。研究从三个相互独立的来源构建了六种候选框架：实验确定的ABX3硼氢化物、数据驱动结构预测得到的畸变钙钛矿，以及对结构数据库进行无偏搜索得到的结构；在后者中，生成的全部2238个候选结构均进行了弛豫，没有排除任何候选。在固定电荷中性的组成下，对每个框架的阳离子排列进行了穷举，共得到420种排列，并进一步归并为118种对称性不等价构型；这些构型先由机器学习势进行筛选，最终通过第一性原理计算确定。最稳定的结构不是钙钛矿，而是空间群为Cm的单斜框架；它仅通过无约束搜索被发现，其能量为−4.185640 eV/atom，比此前可获得的最佳框架低7.67 meV/atom。两个化学上无关的供体原型最终都收敛到该结构，能量差仅为0.076 meV/atom，并且其有序阳离子排列是该结构系列自身的基态。其声子谱在超胞能够精确解析的所有波矢处均不含虚频，弛豫离子弹性张量为正定；相比之下，正交钙钛矿候选结构不稳定，存在−2.401 THz的虚频。这一对比为该组成以钙钛矿形式制备失败的报道提供了物理原因。本文还给出了模拟衍射图谱，其中的七条衍射峰能够识别所预测的框架，而母相和竞争框架均不会产生这些衍射峰。
core_items.summary: NaCa(BH4)3具有11.24 wt.%的理论储氢容量，但此前从未制备成功，也没有报道其晶体结构。本文从多个来源构建候选结构，对所有电荷中性的阳离子排列进行穷举，并结合机器学习势与第一性原理计算进行筛选和确认。结果表明，最稳定结构不是钙钛矿，而是仅由无约束搜索发现的单斜Cm框架；其声子谱和弹性张量均显示稳定性，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在虚频，这为该组成难以形成钙钛矿结构提供了物理解释。
core_items.method_point: 研究从多个来源收集NaCa(BH4)3候选结构，穷举电荷中性的阳离子排列，再以机器学习势进行大规模预筛，最后用第一性原理能量、声子谱和弹性张量确认低能结构。无约束搜索找到单斜Cm框架而非预设钙钛矿；摘要没有给出势函数类型、训练数据、搜索规模、结构弛豫阈值和声子计算设置，不能据此断言使用MACE或NEP。
core_items.related_work: 这一路线与Hongjun Xiang的高通量结构筛选、有效势能面和相稳定性研究直接呼应，也适合Xin-Gao Gong的主动学习与大体系模拟框架。它区别于只在原型结构中替换元素的筛选，使用电荷约束穷举和无偏候选生成，再用晶格动力学过滤虚频；与PbZrO3机器学习势的大尺度动力学相比，此处ML主要承担静态结构搜索而非相变时间演化。
core_items.implication: 可把流程迁移到HfO2多晶型、BaTiO3应变相、二维滑移铁电和卤化物钙钛矿界面：按电荷中性、配位环境和层间堆垛生成候选，用DFT小样本训练MACE或NEP并以不确定度主动补点。筛选后统一计算形成能、声子、弹性、极化和畴壁能，随后用有限温MD验证相变路径；对低能结构进行DFT+U或混合泛函复核，避免势函数误判近简并相。

core_items.title_en: Polarization switching and microscopic domain evolution of ferrielectric phases in antiferroelectric PbZrO₃
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Polarization switching and microscopic domain evolution of ferrielectric phases in antiferroelectric PbZrO₃
